meta.title: Terms of Use — TalentAI
meta.description: Read TalentAI's Terms of Use including EU AI Act compliance disclosures. Understand your rights when using our AI-powered recruitment platform.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.notice: EU AI Act Notice — Regulation (EU) 2024/1689: TalentAI operates a system classified as a high-risk AI system under Annex III, point 4 of the EU AI Act, as it is used in the recruitment and evaluation of candidates. As a user, you benefit from specific rights detailed in these Terms.
terms.intro: Welcome to TalentAI. By accessing or using our platform at <site>app.talentai.bid</site>, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. Please read them carefully before using the service.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.p1: By creating an account, accessing, or using TalentAI in any way, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.
acceptance.p2: These Terms apply to all users of the platform, including companies (employers), candidates, team members, and visitors.

service.title: 2. Description of Service
service.p1: TalentAI is an AI-powered recruitment platform that helps companies automate hiring workflows. Our services include:
items: AI-conducted video interviews that guide candidates through role-specific questions
Automated candidate scoring and evaluation based on interview performance
Blockchain-verified interview credentials issued to candidates
Recruitment campaign management and team collaboration tools
CV analysis and job post generation
service.notice: TalentAI is a decision-support tool. All final hiring decisions remain the sole responsibility of the employer. No recruitment decision may be based exclusively on AI-generated results.

ai.title: 3. High-Risk AI System — EU AI Act Compliance

classification.title: 3.1 System Classification
classification.p1: Under Article 6 and Annex III, point 4 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (the "AI Act"), TalentAI's AI system is classified as a high-risk AI system because it is used in:
items: Recruitment or selection of natural persons, in particular to evaluate candidates
Decisions affecting employment conditions, promotion, or termination of work relationships

transparency.title: 3.2 Transparency towards Candidates (Articles 13 & 50)
transparency.p1: Before any AI interview, candidates are clearly and explicitly informed of:
items: The interview being conducted by an AI system, not a human recruiter
The nature of data collected (video, audio, text responses, behavioural signals)
The evaluation criteria used by the system to score responses
The identity of the company accessing the results
The right to request human review of the evaluation

explanation.title: 3.3 Right to Explanation (Article 86)
explanation.notice: Every candidate has the right to obtain a clear explanation of the role played by the AI system in any decision made about them, including the main criteria considered and how the overall score was determined.
explanation.p1: To exercise this right, contact us at contact@talentai.bid. We commit to responding within 15 business days.

oversight.title: 3.4 Human Oversight (Article 14)
items: Employers retain the ability to review, override, or disregard any AI-generated evaluation
No hiring decision is made in a fully automated manner without the possibility of human intervention
Technical measures allow the system to be stopped or suspended in case of unexpected behaviour

contest.title: 3.5 Right to Contest
contest.p1: Any candidate who believes an AI evaluation was incorrect, biased, or conducted unfairly may:
items: Contact TalentAI at <contact>contact@talentai.bid</contact> to request a review
Request that the hiring company provide human review of their application
File a complaint with the relevant national data protection authority

risk.title: 3.6 Risk Management and Testing (Article 9)
risk.p1: TalentAI maintains a risk management system covering:
items: Regular audits of algorithmic bias in evaluation outputs
Robustness and performance testing of AI models
Automatic logging of AI system decisions (logs retained per Article 12)
Update and correction processes upon detection of anomalies

accounts.title: 4. User Accounts
accounts.p1: To use certain features, you must create an account and provide accurate, complete information. You are responsible for:
items: Keeping your login credentials confidential
All activity that occurs under your account
Notifying us immediately of any unauthorised access at <contact>contact@talentai.bid</contact>
accounts.p2: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms or engage in fraudulent, abusive, or harmful behaviour.

candidateRights.title: 5. Candidate Interviews — Rights
candidateRights.p1: When you participate in an AI interview on TalentAI, you acknowledge that:
itemsA: The interview is conducted by an AI system, not a human recruiter
Your responses, video, and audio may be recorded, analysed, and shared with the hiring company
Results may be stored and referenced in future applications unless you request deletion
You must have the legal right to work in the jurisdiction you are applying in
itemsB: Right to explanation (Art. 86 AI Act) — obtain a clear account of how your score was determined
Right to contest — request human review of your evaluation
Right of access & rectification (Art. 15–16 GDPR) — access your data and request corrections
Right to erasure (Art. 17 GDPR) — request deletion of your personal data
Right to object (Art. 21 GDPR) — object to automated processing of your data

employerResponsibilities.title: 6. Employer Responsibilities
employerResponsibilities.p1: As a company using TalentAI to recruit, you agree to:
items: Use the platform in compliance with applicable employment and data protection laws
Not use AI evaluation results as the sole basis for any employment decision
Inform candidates that their interview will be conducted and evaluated by AI (Article 50 AI Act)
Not post misleading, discriminatory, or illegal job listings
Maintain confidentiality of candidate data obtained through the platform
Retain AI system usage logs as required under Article 26 of the AI Act
employerResponsibilities.notice: As a deployer of a high-risk AI system under the AI Act, your organisation assumes specific legal obligations regarding human oversight and incident reporting. Technical documentation required under Article 13 is available upon request.

nonDiscrimination.title: 7. Non-Discrimination and Algorithmic Bias
nonDiscrimination.notice: TalentAI is committed to designing and maintaining its AI system to minimise discriminatory bias related to gender, ethnic origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. Per Article 10 of the AI Act, representative training data and regular audits are implemented.
nonDiscrimination.p1: If you believe you have been discriminated against by the AI system, please report it to <contact>contact@talentai.bid</contact> or to the relevant national supervisory authority.

ip.title: 8. Intellectual Property
ip.p1: All content, technology, trademarks, and materials on TalentAI — including AI models, interface design, and software — are owned by TalentAI Inc. and protected by applicable intellectual property laws.
ip.p2: You may not copy, modify, distribute, sell, or create derivative works from any part of our platform without our prior written consent.

prohibitedUses.title: 9. Prohibited Uses
items: Attempt to reverse-engineer, scrape, or extract data from the platform
Use automated tools, bots, or scripts to interact with the service
Impersonate another person or entity
Submit false or misleading information during an interview
Interfere with the security, integrity, or availability of the platform
Use the platform for any unlawful purpose or in violation of any regulation

blockchain.title: 10. Blockchain Credentials
blockchain.p1: TalentAI issues interview completion credentials on the Hedera blockchain. These credentials are:
items: Immutable once issued — they cannot be altered or deleted
Verifiable by third parties who hold the credential identifier
Not a guarantee of employment or a formal qualification

liability.title: 11. Limitation of Liability
liability.p1: TalentAI is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, TalentAI Inc. shall not be liable for:
items: Any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform
Hiring outcomes or decisions made based on AI evaluations
Loss of data, revenue, or business opportunities
Any service interruption or technical failure

modifications.title: 12. Modifications to Terms
modifications.p1: We may update these Terms from time to time. We will notify registered users of material changes via email or an in-app notice. Continued use of the platform after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

governingLaw.title: 13. Governing Law
governingLaw.p1: These Terms are governed by applicable law, including Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), and relevant national legislation. Any disputes shall first be addressed through good-faith negotiation, and if unresolved, through the competent jurisdiction.

contact.title: 14. Contact & Exercise of Rights
contact.p1: For questions about these Terms or to exercise any right (explanation, contest, access, erasure, objection), contact us:
contact.responseTime: Response time: 15 business days for AI Act-related requests

meta.title: Privacy Policy — TalentAI
meta.description: Read TalentAI's Privacy Policy. Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal data on our AI-powered recruitment platform.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: TalentAI Inc. ("TalentAI", "we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and share your personal data when you use our platform at <site>app.talentai.bid</site>.

appliesTo.title: 1. Who This Policy Applies To
appliesTo.p1: This policy applies to all users of TalentAI, including:
items: Candidates — individuals who apply for jobs and complete AI interviews
Employers — companies and recruiters who use TalentAI to hire
Team Members — employees invited to a company account
Visitors — anyone browsing our website

dataCollected.title: 2. Data We Collect
candidateItems: Personal identifiers: name, email address, phone number
Resume / CV documents and the data extracted from them
Video and audio recordings from AI interview sessions
Interview responses, AI evaluation scores, and matching results
Skills, work experience, and education history from your profile
Device information, IP address, and browser data (collected automatically)
employerItems: Company name, website, and contact details
Job post content, recruitment campaign data, and interview configurations
Usage data and feature interaction logs

dataUse.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
dataUse.p1: We use the data we collect to:
items: Operate and improve the TalentAI platform
Conduct AI-powered interviews and generate evaluation results
Match candidates with relevant job opportunities
Issue and verify blockchain-based interview credentials
Send transactional emails (interview invitations, reminders, account notifications)
Prevent fraud, abuse, and unauthorised access
Comply with legal obligations
Conduct analytics to improve our service (aggregated and anonymised where possible)
dataUse.p2: We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

aiProcessing.title: 4. AI Processing and Automated Decisions
aiProcessing.p1: TalentAI uses artificial intelligence to analyse candidate responses, generate interview scores, and produce matching assessments. You have the right to:
items: Be informed that automated processing is taking place (as disclosed at the point of interview)
Request human review of any automated decision that significantly affects you
Object to solely automated decision-making where required by applicable law
aiProcessing.p2: All AI-generated evaluations are provided as decision-support tools. Final hiring decisions are made by the employer, not TalentAI.

dataSharing.title: 5. Data Sharing
dataSharing.p1: We may share your data with:
items: Hiring companies — employers receive candidate profiles, interview recordings, and evaluation scores for roles you applied to
Service providers — trusted third parties who process data on our behalf (cloud infrastructure, email delivery, payment processing) under strict data protection agreements
Hedera network — anonymised credential hashes are recorded on the Hedera public blockchain for verification purposes
Legal authorities — where required by law, court order, or to protect the rights and safety of our users

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
retention.p1: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide our services. Specifically:
items: Interview recordings and scores are retained for up to 24 months after the application
Account data is retained until account deletion is requested
Blockchain credential hashes are permanent and cannot be deleted by nature of the technology
Billing records are retained as required by applicable tax law
retention.p2: You may request deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us at <contact>contact@talentai.bid</contact>. Deletion requests will be processed within 30 days, subject to legal retention requirements.

rights.title: 7. Your Rights
rights.p1: Depending on your location, you may have the right to:
items: Access — request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
Rectification — ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data
Erasure — request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten")
Portability — receive your data in a machine-readable format
Objection — object to certain types of processing, including automated decisions
Restriction — request that we limit how we use your data
rights.p2: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at <contact>contact@talentai.bid</contact>.

cookies.title: 8. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.p1: TalentAI uses cookies and similar technologies to keep you logged in, remember your preferences, and understand how you use the platform. You can control cookie settings through your browser. Disabling certain cookies may affect platform functionality.

security.title: 9. Data Security
security.p1: We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption in transit (TLS), access controls, and secure cloud infrastructure. However, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure. We encourage you to use a strong, unique password and to report any suspected security issues to <contact>contact@talentai.bid</contact>.

transfers.title: 10. International Data Transfers
transfers.p1: TalentAI operates globally. Your data may be processed in countries outside your own. Where we transfer data internationally, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place in accordance with applicable data protection law.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
changes.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via email or an in-app notice. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page will always reflect the most recent version.

contact.title: 12. Contact Us
contact.p1: For any privacy-related questions, requests, or concerns, please contact our team at: <contact>contact@talentai.bid</contact>
